location_exception_reason: PVC portable cabins are manufactured products with standardised specifications (panel thickness, frame gauge, dimensions). Location of manufacture or seller does not alter the product's functional attributes or buyer decision criteria. Buyers select based on cabin size, insulation type, and frame material — not origin geography.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) in titles are redundant; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from 'PVC Portable Cabin Manufacturer' leaves the product definition complete and unchanged. The product is a PVC portable cabin regardless of seller classification.
